name: agglomerative-clustering
description: Colour palette extraction and image quantization with exact Ward clustering, in WebAssembly. Cluster an image once, then cut it to a palette of any size.
author: Rohan Fredriksson

scripts.build:wasm: mkdirp dist && em++ src/clustering.cpp -O3 -msimd128 -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORT_NAME='createWasmModule' -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s INITIAL_MEMORY=32MB -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=2147483648 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS="['_library_version','_get_clustering','_clustering_job_start','_clustering_job_step','_clustering_job_result','_clustering_job_free','_get_palette','_get_palette_from_clustering','_get_palette_weights','_quantize','_quantize_with_clustering','_quantize_with_palette','_quantize_indices','_quantize_indices_with_clustering','_quantize_indices_with_palette','_malloc','_free']" -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS="['HEAPU8']" -o dist/clustering.js && node scripts/patch-glue.mjs
scripts.build:cjs: cross-env BABEL_ENV=cjs babel src --out-dir dist --extensions ".js" --ignore "src/worker-thread.js" --out-file-extension .cjs && node scripts/patch-cjs.mjs
scripts.build:types: mkdirp dist && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); for (const f of ['index.d.ts', 'worker.d.ts']) {fs.copyFileSync('src/' + f, 'dist/' + f);} fs.copyFileSync('src/index.d.ts', 'dist/index.d.cts'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/worker.d.cts', fs.readFileSync('src/worker.d.ts', 'utf8').replaceAll(\"'./index.js'\", \"'./index.cjs'\"));"
scripts.build:js: npm run build:types && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm
scripts.build: node scripts/sync-version.mjs --check && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:js
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add src/shared.js src/version.hpp
scripts.test:types: tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.nodenext.json && tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.bundler.json && tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.node.json
